hero-knight.text: Dung order, quay phai, khien va kiem ro, doc duoc o co nho

hero-axeman.text: Dung order, rau ram, rui hai luoi, mau cam nau ro

hero-swordsman.text: Dung order va quay phai, nhung dau nho va than cao hon 4 hero kia, ti le dau than chua dong bo

hero-archer.text: Dung order, cung giuong ve phai, ong ten sau lung, xanh la ro

hero-mage.text: Dung order, mu nhon ao tim, gay phep da vang giuong ve phai
